What You’ll Do

Do you love hearing candidates say, "thank you for a great recruiting experience"? As a Recruiter on our team, you’ll play a key role in attracting, engaging, and hiring top talent across both technical and non-technical roles. You will:

  • Source active and passive candidates through a variety of channels, building strong pipelines of talent.
  • Aggressively source and build pipelines of high-quality passive and active candidates using innovative and diverse strategies—Boolean search, talent mapping, networking, referrals, and social media outreach.
  • Screen candidates to assess qualifications and guide them smoothly through the interview process.
  • Proactively communicate with candidates throughout the process, ensuring clarity, transparency, and a positive reflection of the phData brand.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand their needs, design effective recruiting strategies, and consult on best practices.
  • Lead the offer stage, including extending offers and negotiating compensation.
  • Coordinate interview logistics and scheduling with efficiency, ensuring readiness of both candidates and panelists.
  • Collaborate across multiple teams—data analytics, engineering, managed services, program management, and more—ensuring we bring the best talent into every corner of the business.

Requirements

  • 5–8 years of recruiting experience in a fast-paced environment.
  • At least 3 years of technical recruiting experience.
  • Full-cycle recruiting expertise, from sourcing through closing and negotiation.
  • Proven ability to engage and convert passive candidates.
  • Experience leveraging data and analytics to assess sourcing effectiveness and refine strategies.
  • Solid understanding of recruiting metrics and KPIs (time-to-fill, source-of-hire, pipeline conversion, satisfaction).
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to thrive in a lean team environment.
  • Professional-level English communication skills (reading, writing, speaking).

Responsibilities

  • Manage the end-to-end recruiting lifecycle: sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, and supporting offers.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates, delivering an excellent and timely candidate experience.
  • Prioritize and manage multiple open positions across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Maintain excellence across core recruitment KPIs, including time-to-fill, source-of-hire, pipeline conversion, and candidate/hiring manager satisfaction.
  • Partner with hiring managers in a consultative capacity, advising on recruitment strategy, interview process, and market insights.
  • Use phData’s recruiting tools and systems to manage candidate pipelines, improve operational efficiency, and ensure data accuracy and compliance.
  • Schedule and coordinate all candidate interviews, ensuring a seamless experience for candidates and panelists.
  • Collaborate with the TA leadership and hiring teams to align on workforce planning and support talent development initiatives.
  • Uphold and continuously improve best practices across recruitment operations—including job postings, social campaigns, ATS workflows, and candidate communications.
  • Represent phData with professionalism, integrity, and alignment to our mission, vision, and core values.

Who You Are

  • Innovative – You’re eager to test new approaches and continuously improve.
  • Curious – You love to learn and stay ahead of recruiting trends.
  • Adaptable – You thrive in change and adjust quickly to evolving business needs.
  • Process-Driven – You identify opportunities for efficiency and implement improvements.
  • Tech-Savvy – You’re comfortable navigating recruiting systems and tools.
  • Energetic – You bring enthusiasm and urgency to a fast-paced environment.
  • Results-Oriented – You’re motivated by achieving goals and connecting world-class talent with meaningful opportunities.
  • Connected – You stay current with industry trends and maintain a strong recruiter network while engaging with talent communities.

Why phData?

  • Remote-First Work Environment
  • Casual, award-winning small-business work environment
  • Collaborative high performance culture that prizes autonomy, creativity, and transparency
  • Competitive comp, excellent benefits, generous weeks PTO plus 10 Holidays (and other cool perks)
  • Accelerated learning and professional development through advanced training and certifications

phData celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at phData. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Hľadáme samostatnú osobu, ktorá je pripravená presadiť Storyous na Slovensku. V Českej republike je Storyous už obľúbenou značkou v oblasti pohostinstva. Nebudete len vykonávať úlohy – budete prichádzať s novými nápadmi, testovať ich a sledovať, ako sa stávajú skutočnosťou. S podporou nášho tímu v Prahe a externej reklamnej agentúry pre PPC kampane budete mať voľnosť realizovať nové nápady a zároveň budete zodpovedný za miestnu značku Storyous na Slovensku.

title: Prefeitura capacita servidores em evento nacional de licitações
description:
Overview

Com o compromisso de aprimorar a gestão pública e fortalecer a eficiência das contratações municipais, a Prefeitura investiu na participação de 12 servidores da Secretaria Especial de Licitações e Contratos (SELC) no Pregão Week 2025, um dos mais importantes eventos do país voltados à área de licitações e contratos administrativos. O encontro foi realizado entre os dias 20 e 24 de outubro, em Foz do Iguaçu (PR).

Programa e temas

Durante cinco dias de programação intensiva, o evento reuniu especialistas de referência nacional, proporcionando 30 horas de imersão técnica com palestras, painéis e oficinas práticas. O objetivo foi atualizar e aprofundar o conhecimento dos participantes sobre a Lei nº 14.133/2021, a Nova Lei de Licitações e Contratos, destacando seus impactos, inovações e desafios para a administração pública moderna.

  • Inversão de fases
  • Novas modalidades e modos de disputa
  • Procedimentos auxiliares
  • Uso da inteligência artificial nos processos licitatórios
  • Responsabilidade dos pregoeiros
  • Aplicação de critérios sustentáveis nas contratações públicas

Participantes e patrocínio técnico

O Pregão Week 2025 contou com a presença de renomados juristas e professores, como Ronny Charles, Victor Amorim, Tatiana Camarão, Christianne Stroppa, Marcos Nóbrega, Rafael Sérgio de Oliveira, Vanice Valle, Anderson Pedra e Viviane Mafissoni, profissionais de reconhecida experiência acadêmica e prática. A programação também teve a participação especial do presidente do Tribunal de Contas da União (TCU), ministro Vital do Rêgo, reforçando o alto nível técnico e institucional do encontro.

Impacto esperado

O investimento na formação dos servidores representa um compromisso direto com a qualidade da administração pública e com a eficiência dos serviços prestados à população.

“O fortalecimento técnico da equipe de licitações reflete em contratações mais seguras, transparentes e eficientes. Campo Grande tem buscado constantemente aprimorar seus processos, e a capacitação dos servidores é um pilar essencial dessa transformação”, destaca a prefeita Adriane Lopes.

Para o secretário especial de Licitações e Contratos, André de Moura Brandão, o conhecimento adquirido será multiplicado internamente, beneficiando toda a estrutura administrativa.

“O aprendizado obtido durante o evento permitirá que os servidores da SELC apliquem práticas mais modernas e alinhadas à legislação, ampliando a segurança jurídica e a eficiência das contratações públicas”, ressalta.

A iniciativa reforça a visão estratégica da Prefeitura de Campo Grande em valorizar o servidor público, promovendo a formação continuada e consolidar o município como referência nacional em transparência, inovação e governança nas compras públicas.

title: Legal and Compliance Officer Sao Paolo Legal
description:
About the job

Unlimit is a holder of various regulatory permissions in the banking and payment industry in multiple regions, including the EU, the UK, Latin America, Asia, India, Africa. Further to that Unlimit is an active member of worldwide and regional payment card associations, various payment methods and networks.

As a reflection of our continued growth on the global market, we are hiring a Legal and Compliance Officer (Brazil) to join our team and lead the Legal and Compliance area in Brazil.

The Legal and Compliance Officer provides diversified in-house legal and compliance services, actionable and proactive coverage and support of the areas. The role involves managing simple and complex legal and compliance matters in connection with Unlimint’s Brazil business, and related business interests of Unlimit Group.

The main responsibility

is to ensure comprehensive and ongoing in-house legal and compliance related coverage of Unlimit’s business and related interests in Brazil, as well as part of Unlimit Group, and locations where we operate or plan to work in, and in business sectors of our interests. The Legal and Compliance Officer (Brazil) is expected to provide coverage of legal and compliance matters for the Brazil business, and as part of the wider global business.

To achieve this, your role as Legal and Compliance Officer (Brazil) will involve effectively working as part of a multi-national legal and compliance (regulatory, AML, data protection) teams, establishing performing and managing relevant legal and compliance function processes, working closely with key stakeholders (including operational functions, internal control functions and with C-level on a local and global level) across the Group.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage and provide ongoing legal and regulatory compliance coverage for the Brazil business
  • Research and provide actionable advice on legal, regulatory and compliance matters in Brazil, and as part of the wider global business.
  • Provide ongoing coverage for legal, regulatory and compliance matters, business and operational purposes of various significance levels in Brazil, as well as part of wider global business.
  • Identify applicable requirements and ensure compliance with them within the prescribed timelines.
  • Handle/participate in various licensing, participation and registration processes with competent authorities (BACEN etc.)
  • Draft, prepare, review and negotiate internal documents such as policies, guidelines, frameworks, procedures, manuals, instructions etc. on various matters in accordance with regulatory and internal requirements such as regulatory compliance, AML, data protection, security, governance and others related to the payments and financial industry. Supervise Unlimint Brazil business in their respect.
  • Handle participation / membership with local and international payment systems and payment networks and counterparties (Card Schemes such as Mastercard, Visa, Elo and other systems such as PIX etc)
  • Contractual review and management of relations with banks, payment systems and payment networks
  • Design and handle in-house projects of legal and compliance, and cross-departmental projects (with operational units, control function units and business units). Monitor internal statuses, implementations, provide actionable solutions and systems. Advise on, ensure and monitor due reporting obligations to and communication with competent authorities (including BACEN and government authorities) and counterparties.
  • Draft, prepare, review and negotiate various documents such as agreements, resolutions, applications, forms, questionnaires, resolutions, letters, explanations, etc.
  • Draft standardised agreements, templates etc. related to Unlimit’s business.
  • Manage corporate matters (establishing, recording keeping, updating, performance of necessary filings etc.) in relation to Unlimit Brazil and companies and corporate structure
  • Manage legal matters and projects on diverse topics: including employment and staff matters (preparing, drafting and reviewing various legal agreements, documents, research etc.), legal research, guidance and advice to various functions of the company (operational, internal control functions, HR, Finance etc),
  • business and client related matters, client inquiries, claims and disputes etc. Manage daily legal support, including draft, prepare, review and negotiate various documents such agreements, standard terms and conditions, resolutions, applications, forms, questionnaires, letters, explanations, internal procedures and regulations, etc.
  • Participate in and manage specialised matters involving banking and payment sector regulations, technological elements and agreements, data protection, intellectual property (organising, research, drafting and reviewing various legal documents, presentation of solutions to stakeholders and management etc.).
  • Negotiate with third parties, communicate with competent authorities, facilitate our business, protect and defend our interests.
  • Liaise with and assist other competent internal functions within Unlimint in the performance of their duties.
  • Establish and ensure effective collaboration with third parties and external service providers (legal and consulting services providers, auditors, and other counterparties).
  • Plan, structure and implement projects, management systems, deals and collaborations.
  • Participate hands-on in local and cross-regional team projects.
  • Develop budgets for assigned tasks where necessary.
  • Conduct various legal projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Be comfortable with handling diverse routine legal work (contract reviews, negotiations with counterparties) and related compliance work (filings, letters and communication with regulatory and competent authorities and various payment networks)
  • Ensure that the Brazilian business meets its regulatory requirements and mitigates AML/CTF risks to avoid breaches, fines, and regulatory sanctions.
  • Provide advice and assistance to other functions dealing with AML-related matters.
  • Respond to external and internal requests regarding AML compliance.
  • Conduct staff training on AML/CTF.
  • Monitor developments and new trends in the Brazilian and international AML/CTF framework.
  • Draft, update, and implement AML/CTF internal documentation.
  • Report internally/externally on ML/TF matters.

Who You Are

  • University degree in Law.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on diversified & broad legal and compliance experience in Brazil. Broad legal experience in a multinational/global organisation is preferred
  • In-house legal and compliance and AML/anti-fraud experience in the payments/banking/financial sector is a must.
  • Experience in Brazil financial regulation is a must - knowledge and experience in payment services regulations, BACEN regulation, including regulation, AML, data protection, consumer protection etc.
  • Comfort to perform both low- & high-level tasks.
  • Hands-on experience in commercial law with national and cross-border contracts
  • Hands-on experience with employment law and corporate law
  • Legal coverage of local & international projects (including ones that are subject to special regulations)
  • Able to deliver effective on-going monitoring, managing, performing and support of legal and compliance areas, projects, agreements and arrangements
  • Self-starter able to work with minimum supervision. Able to work independently, as part of a team and as team lead for projects (including cross-jurisdictional and remote teams) such as licensing, participations in payment networks and arrangements.
  • Excellent research and analysis skills. Able to analyse and present complex information clearly and concisely to various stakeholders
  • Able to meet deadlines and comfortable with changing requirements and priorities. Confidence in decision-making and managing ambiguity.
  • Legal and business-friendly judgment, skilled in building consensus across cross-functional stakeholders and C-level.
  • Knowledge & comfort with new technologies and the digital sphere.
  • Knowledge of industry standards and (internal and external) auditing procedures
  • Ability to interface professionally and effectively with third parties, counterparties, regulators, auditors
  • Ability to provide commercially astute risk-based advice and recommendations for business
  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills. Ability to present complex and ambiguous information in a clear manner, devising understandable steps and actions in a commercial setting.
  • Strong people management and leadership skills, ability to run working groups/projects.
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills
  • CAMS or ICA certification is a bonus
  • Excellent English and Portuguese is an absolute must

What We Offer

  • Attractive monthly remuneration paid in line with experience
  • Vacation, sick, and paid holidays
  • Full-time: 5/2 (Saturday and Sunday days off)
  • Modern workplace based in Sao Paolo, Brazil.
  • A team of top international professionals to learn from
  • Multicultural working environment

Join Unlimit Team now!

We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief.

title: Security Incident Response Specialist
description:
Security Engineer - Pessoa desenvolvedora com Foco em Segurança - Pleno

A Unico é a maior rede de verificação de identidade do mundo e um pilar de confiança na sociedade digital. Com soluções baseadas em biometria facial, machine learning e camadas reforçadas de segurança, autenticamos com 100% de certeza quem está realizando uma transação e os riscos de identidade atrelados. Desta forma, nossas soluções combatem fraudes, protegem dados e promovem a confiança entre pessoas, empresas e governos, colaborando para a construção de um mundo mais seguro e menos burocrático. Para chegar lá, investimos acima de tudo nas nossas pessoas, que formam um time incrível e comprometido com esse grande objetivo. E aí, vem com a gente?

Nossa cultura

Nossos valores são a base para tudo que fazemos! Aqui na Unico, agimos sem fronteiras; impactamos sem rodeios; somos transparentes mesmo em situações difíceis; resilientes e adaptáveis para evoluir; fazemos a coisa certa do jeito certo e somos ousados ao liderar a construção do futuro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é descontraído e colaborativo, cheio de oportunidades de aprendizado e possibilidades para você desenvolver sua carreira com autonomia e apoio de líderes e colegas.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Atuar como ponto focal técnico na gestão de incidentes e crises de segurança de média a alta complexidade, desde a triagem e análise forense até a contenção e remediação (post-mortems).
  • (MDR/Blue Team): Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar regras de detecção (use cases), painéis e alertas de segurança em plataformas como SIEM/SOAR.
  • Liderar atividades proativas de Threat Hunting e exercícios de simulação de ataque (Purple Team), identificando ameaças persistentes e brechas na proteção.
  • Automação de Segurança (SOAR): Projetar e implementar playbooks e automações utilizando SOAR para otimizar a resposta a incidentes, reduzir o MTTR (Mean Time to Respond) e escalar as operações de segurança.
  • Colaborar com os times de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura na avaliação de risco e definição de prioridades de mitigação para vulnerabilidades críticas.
  • Criar e manter a documentação de segurança (runbooks, playbooks, manuais) e participar da definição de políticas e padrões de segurança da informação, alinhados a frameworks como NIST, MITRE ATT&CK e ISO 27001.
  • Apoiar na avaliação técnica de novas ferramentas, definir requisitos de implementação e garantir a integração eficaz de soluções de segurança (CloudFlare, CrowdStrike, Netskope, etc.) em ambientes de nuvem (AWS/GCP).

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Vasta experiência técnica em Cibersegurança, com foco em Resposta a Incidentes (CSIRT) e Operações de Segurança (SOC/Blue Team).
  • Conhecimento profundo e domínio prático de frameworks como MITRE ATT&CK e NIST, e proficiência em ferramentas de detecção, investigação e resposta (SIEM, EDR, Firewall, etc.).
  • Experiência comprovada em SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response) e scripting para automação de tarefas de segurança.
  • Sólida capacidade de realizar análises forenses básicas a intermediárias e reconstrução de eventos durante incidentes.
  • Excelente capacidade de remover obstáculos, antecipar problemas e tomar decisões técnicas assertivas sob pressão em cenários de crise.
  • Habilidade para atuar como ponto focal de segurança e comunicar riscos e status de incidentes de forma clara a diferentes públicos (técnico e executivo).
  • Conhecimento prático em ambientes de nuvem (preferencialmente AWS e GCP) e arquiteturas de contêineres.

Desejável (Nice to Have)

  • Experiência em fraudes mobile e biometria.

Benefícios

  • Benefício flexível: R$1.500,00 por mês que podem ser distribuídos nas modalidades VA/VR, Cultura, Mobilidade e Flex Férias.
  • Auxílio home office: valor mensal de R$120,00 para pagamento de contas e consumo.
  • PLR: elegível a Participação nos Lucros e Resultados conforme acordo sindical.
  • Benefício Educação: a Unico financia 100% dos estudos para 100% dos colaboradores através de cursos disponíveis na plataforma Unico Skill. Você pode escolher entre graduação, pós-graduação, MBAs, idiomas, cursos especializantes e mentorias.
  • Bem-estar: acesso à plataformas como Gympass e Totalpass.
  • Licença parental estendida: 180 dias para gestantes e cuidadores principais do processo de adoção e 60 dias para não gestantes e cuidados secundários do processo de adoção, com salário e benefícios pagos integralmente ao longo de todo o período.

Local de trabalho

Adotamos o modelo de trabalho que prioriza o remoto, o nosso #tetounico. Isso significa que os Seres têm a opção de frequentar os escritórios caso queiram, e de acordo com as necessidades de cada área. Temos escritórios nas cidades de São Paulo e Londrina.

Diversidade & Inclusão

Na Unico estamos empenhados em construir uma cultura inclusiva, valorizando em todas as nossas posições a candidatura de todas as pessoas, independentemente de sua etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, política, religião, deficiência, naturalidade ou qualquer outro tipo de característica.

Estamos construindo um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e, para nos apoiar em melhores práticas, criamos o formulário de Diversidade & Inclusão. Te convidamos a respondê-lo pra nos ajudar nesse processo, mas deixamos claro que você pode optar por não fazer isso sem impacto na sua avaliação. O compartilhamento desses dados não irá afetar o seu desempenho no processo seletivo e será usado somente para fins de criação de estratégias de inclusão.

Objective: Mine rocks for resources like iron, gold, and explosives.

How to Work

Approach a rock and press the fire button (Left Mouse Button - LMB) to mine it.

A cursor will appear, and you can click on a rock to begin mining.

After mining, the resources can be sold on F7 or used for crafting at F9.

If you wish to stop mining, simply click LMB again.

  • Gold Ore: Gold-colored rock (rare)
  • Chemicals: Found underwater in the LS Miner, requires an O2 tank for diving (available via F9)

What to Do with Resources

Gold: Can be sold or used to craft Wedding Rings at F9.

Explosives & Iron: Can be used to craft ammo types or sold at F7.

Crafting Items

Press F9 to open the crafting menu. Select the item you want to craft and check if you have the necessary ingredients. Once ready, click Craft to complete the process.

Rappelez-vous la dernière fois que vous avez ouvert une bouteille de champagne*, une bière fraîche* ou une bouteille d'eau minérale pétillante pour vous désaltérer… elle a probablement été fabriquée par O-I !

Nous avons plus d'un siècle d'expérience dans la fabrication d'emballages en verre : pur, sain et recyclable à l’infini. Nous sommes une organisation durable, nous cherchons à trouver un équilibre dans notre écosystème, entre les besoins de chacun, des organisations et de la planète. Nous travaillons pour de nombreuses marques du secteur agroalimentaire parmi les plus connues au monde. Nous sommes fiers de fournir des emballages en verre de haute qualité pour le marché de la bière, du vin, des spiritueux, de l’alimentaire et des boissons non alcoolisées.

Avec environ 26 000 employés et une présence inégalée grâce à près de 80 usines réparties dans 23 pays, O-I est un acteur mondial où vous pourrez vous développer à travers de nombreux métiers dans un environnement multiculturel.

*l’abus d’alcool est dangereux pour la santé

Description du poste

Sur le site de Vayres, ce sont près d’1,5 millions de bouteilles de vin, crémant et spiritueux produites chaque jour. L’usine fonctionne en feu continu (5x8), Pour répondre aux exigences de nos clients, chaque jour, les 240 salariés se mobilisent pour créer un produit qui répond en tout point aux attentes de nos clients.

L'équipe du service Electrique recherche:

Un(e)Animateur(rice) Technique Pôle Usine en CDI

Mission : En tant qu’Animateur Pôle Usine (F/H), vous intervenez sur l’ensemble du site de Vayres. A ce titre, vous intervenez sur des missions de terrain et collaborez avec l’ensemble de nos services dans une quête d’amélioration et de prévention. Les missions que vous serons confiées sont les suivantes :

  • Assurer la maintenance curative et préventive de toutes les installations comprises dans votre périmètre et consigner les actions réalisées dans la GMAO
  • Assurer un retour quotidien de ses activités auprès de sa hiérarchie et s’assurer du passage de consignes aux équipes postés
  • Coordonner les travaux de maintenance, d’investissement ou d’amélioration et réalise le cahier des charges, la consultation et le choix des fournisseurs, la demande d’achat, le suivi et la réception des travaux
  • Assurer la veille technologique et être force de proposition et d’amélioration
  • Participer à la réalisation et/ou à l’amélioration de standards faisant partie de son périmètres
  • Organiser et coordonner les activités des personnes affectées à son pôle
  • Assurer la formation et transmettre ses compétences techniques aux autres membres du service électrique

Bac +2 des métiers de la maintenance en électricité/électrotechnique

Bonnes connaissances techniques et fonctionnelles des métiers de l'électrotechnique

Maitrise des outils informatique

Capacité d'autonomie et d'animation dans le domaine de la maintenance

Capacité de conduite, de suivi et de réception de projet

Connaissance sur la distribution électrique haute tension et basse tension

Bonnes connaissances en automatisme

Informations complémentaires

Date de démarrage souhaitée : dès que possible

Si vous êtes, passionné(e), créatif(ve), ouvert(e) aux organisations multiculturelles, curieux(se), collaboratif(ve), nous aimerions en connaître davantage sur vous.

O-I s’engage à offrir un environnement de travail collaboratif et crée une culture ouverte aux idées innovantes et donne des perspectives encourageantes de croissance tout en valorisant la performance.

Dans le cadre de notre politique inclusion et diversité, nos postes sont ouverts à tous. Ils peuvent faire l’objet d’une adaptation en cas de situation de handicap.

Toutes vos informations demeureront confidentielles en vertu des directives sur l'égalité d'accès à l'emploi.

title: Tech Lead, Android Core Product - Barueri, Brazil
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

With the growth of our Android app, being the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, we find the need for a Senior Android Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push us forward.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

What You’ll Do

  • Owning major features and working closely with our design team - take ownership of features inside the app and become responsible of delivering high quality features
  • Shape the future of our Android team
  • Own, maintain and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Participate in discussions across different teams - Product, Design, Engineering
  • Review pull requests, and support other teammates
  • Handle critical issues or cope with unexpected challenges
  • Take ownership of feature releases and provide nightly builds for the QA team

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Familiarity with Android components
  • Experience building or contributing to at least one Android app
  • Product design intuition and user empathy
  • Drive to push the boundaries of Android UI/UX
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing tests
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase above and beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Rock solid experience with Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android Animations, Jetpack Navigation, JUnit tests
  • Excellent communication skills
  • User oriented problem solving approach
  • Driven with continuous feedback from leaders

Bonus:

  • Experience building, maintaining, or otherwise contributing to open source projects in Android
  • Experience with iOS, Web or NodeJS

Technologies we use:

  • Kotlin
  • Kotlin Coroutines
  • Kotlin Flow
  • Jetpack Navigation
  • Dagger 2
  • Room
  • Custom Views, Canvas & Paint
  • Jetpack Compose
  • JUnit

What We offer:

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.
  • An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.
  • A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.
  • An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.
  • Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.
  • Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.
  • Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.
  • Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.

About Grupo Pereira

Fundado em 1962, na cidade de Itajaí, em Santa Catarina, o Grupo Pereira tem o propósito de "Ser um bom lugar para passar a vida, nos transformando, transformando as pessoas e o ambiente ao nosso redor".

Com 20 mil funcionários e 800 representantes comerciais autônomos nos Estados de Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Goiás, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, São Paulo e no Distrito Federal, o Grupo Pereira tem mais 125 unidades de negócio, sendo 31 lojas do Comper (rede de supermercados), 60 lojas do Fort Atacadista (atacarejo), 3 filiais do Atacado Bate Forte (atacadista de distribuição), 1 Broker (distribuidora da rede Nestlé), 23 lojas SempreFort (varejo farmacêutico), 5 lojas Pera Turismo (Agência de Viagens) e 2 postos de combustíveis.

Completando o ecossistema de soluções para o cliente, também fazem parte dos negócios do Grupo Pereira o braço logístico Perlog e o de serviços financeiros Vuon, que inclui o private label Vuon Card, com mais de 1 milhão de cartões emitidos, além de seguros e assistência odontológica.

Com a missão de oferecer uma experiência de compra positiva por meio de excelência no relacionamento com clientes, fornecedores e funcionários, o Grupo Pereira colabora com a sociedade por meio de diferentes programas socioambientais.

description:
VENHA TRANSFORMAR O AGRO COM A GENTE!

O #TeamFarm está crescendo e queremos você com a gente!

Desde 2017, lideramos a revolução do crédito no agronegócio. Já viabilizamos mais de R$ 25 bilhões para fortalecer esse ecossistema tão importante, conectando todos os elos da cadeia agro: da indústria ao produtor rural.

Nosso time é feito de #farmers incríveis , com diferentes histórias e experiências, unidos por um propósito: facilitar o acesso ao crédito rápido, simples e seguro e liderar a transformação do agro no Brasil.

Aqui na Farm, fazemos do nosso jeito, com a nossa cara:

• Cliente no centro de tudo.

• Colaboração que transforma.

Acreditamos que o agro muda o mundo. E você pode fazer parte dessa mudança!

Vem com a gente “Do clique pra dentro” .

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES

  • Conciliação das carteiras e cotas dos fundos
  • Execução dos processos de cessão e originação envolvendo validação de XMLs, formalização dos títulos, elegibilidade na plataforma fluxo de informações entre Farm (comercial, investimentos, cadastro e sustentação) X Agentes de Formalização e Cobrança X Custodiante e Administrador Fundo
  • Conciliação das contas de cobrança dos fundos
  • Formalização das renegociações / confissões de dívida
  • Acompanhamento da liquidação das operações de desembolso e de derivativos (hedges) junto as contrapartes
  • Realização dos cálculos do MTM diário dos derivativos (Opções, Futuro, Termo, Swaps e NDFs)
  • Realização dos cálculos e geração dos relatórios diários de caixa e disponibilidade dos fundos
  • Realização de parametrizações na plataforma

HARD SKILLS

  • Formação Concluída ou em andamento (nível Superior): Administração, contabilidade, economia, engenharia ou áreas correlatadas;
  • Vivência em: Back office Fundos, Operações, Custódia, FIDCs, Administração Fiduciária
  • Excel: Intermediário

SOFT SKILLS

  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Resolução de problemas
  • Organização
  • Proatividade
  • Pensamento critico
  • Autonomia

POR QUE A FARM?

Além de um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo, colaborativo e dinâmico, aqui você terá a chance de participar de um projeto com impacto real no agro brasileiro. Com a gente, você vai crescer, desafiar o status quo e construir o futuro do crédito.

About The Company

Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais. About The Team/role

Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de Key Accounts (KA) para liderar e gerenciar a nossa estratégia de relacionamento com as maiores contas do 99Abastece em âmbito nacional. O profissional será responsável por coordenar a gestão das contas, garantindo o desenvolvimento e a manutenção estratégica do nosso portfólio de postos de combustível. O objetivo é assegurar o alto desempenho desses parceiros na plataforma do 99Abastece, identificando e implementando oportunidades de crescimento rentável. O candidato ideal deve ter um perfil hands‑on e estratégico, focado em fomentar parcerias de longo prazo. A função exige a liderança de um modelo de colaboração ganha‑ganha , onde o sucesso da 99 e dos nossos parceiros de negócios andam lado a lado. Será preciso conduzir análises de desempenho, na proposição de soluções inovadoras e na busca constante por excelência na entrega de resultados.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão Estratégica e Consultoria: Atuar como consultor estratégico, capacitando a equipe a adquirir um entendimento profundo do negócio dos postos. O objetivo é que o time de KA ofereça uma visão analítica e contribua com planos de ação sólidos para otimizar o desempenho, garantindo uma colaboração mútua e resultados de crescimento.
  • Liderança e Relacionamento: Liderar a equipe como principal ponto de contato com os parceiros‑chave. O coordenador deve promover uma comunicação próxima e constante, garantindo que o time responda proativamente às necessidades dos postos, resolva desafios e implemente estratégias comerciais alinhadas aos objetivos da 99Abastece.
  • Análise de Desempenho e Proposição de Valor: Coordenar a análise de dados para desenvolver uma compreensão profunda do comportamento dos parceiros. O coordenador será responsável por guiar a equipe na elaboração e na apresentação de estratégias comerciais convincentes, com o objetivo de aumentar a participação e a fidelização da carteira.
  • Visão de Negócio e Parceria: Fomentar uma cultura de relacionamento de longo prazo, baseada na confiança e em uma mentalidade genuinamente ganha‑ganha. O objetivo é garantir que o sucesso dos postos de gasolina parceiros se traduza diretamente em crescimento sustentável para a 99.

Qualificações

  • Graduação em Administração, Marketing, Negócios Internacionais ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência sólida de 2 anos ou mais em gestão de contas e vendas consultivas, preferencialmente com conhecimento no mercado de combustíveis.
  • Capacidade e flexibilidade para se adaptar e aprender, trabalhando em um ambiente de startup acelerado, em constante mudança e com metas desafiadoras.
  • Habilidades interpessoais: Comunicação oral e escrita comprovadas, com capacidade de persuadir e manter relacionamentos de trabalho construtivos, assertivos, colaborativos e cooperativos com clientes internos e externos, em organizações multinacionais.
  • Habilidades analíticas: Capacidade de diagnosticar, entender as tendências de mercado e implementar um plano de ação.
  • Senso de urgência e motivação para alcançar objetivos, analisando os cenários possíveis.

We create user value. We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient. We are data‑driven. We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data‑driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics. Win‑win Collaboration: Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do. We believe in integrity. Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other. Growth: We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow. Diversity and Inclusion: Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Sobre a Vaga:

Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve refletir a individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo autonomia e qualidade de vida aos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos Fisioterapeutas Visitadores , apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas comunidades.

Diagnóstico que Buscamos:

  • Formação em Fisioterapia e registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Fisioterapia (CREFITO).
  • Experiência prévia em atenção domiciliar ou saúde comunitária será um diferencial.
  • Paixão por promover o autocuidado e a autonomia dos pacientes, com abordagem centrada na pessoa.
  • Habilidade em comunicação e empatia, essenciais para estabelecer vínculos com pacientes e familiares.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e multidisciplinar, integrando ações que promovam a saúde do paciente em seu ambiente familiar.
  • Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes.

Sobre Nós

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, refletido em nossa equipe composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um Fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajudar a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

Proporcionar cuidados de alta qualidade, respeito, compaixão e empatia aos idosos, promovendo seu bem-estar físico, emocional e psicológico, garantindo segurança e integridade do paciente, prevenindo e tratando problemas de saúde relacionados à mobilidade. O Fisioterapeuta com ênfase no tratamento de idosos desempenha papel crucial na educação do paciente, praticando cuidados adequados e promovendo orientações e acompanhamento para envelhecimento saudável e digno.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Atuar alinhado aos valores da organização, mantendo conduta focada em resultados do cuidado, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente, e tornando a assistência personalizada.
  • Registrar no prontuário do paciente informações essenciais ao processo de cuidado, mantendo-os atualizados.
  • Ser representante da organização, zelando por suas premissas, e prestando cuidado baseado em evidências científicas e melhores práticas.
  • Realizar cuidado integral ao paciente, com empatia e carinho, estabelecendo vínculos e considerando suas necessidades biopsicossociais.
  • Garantir a continuidade da assistência em fisioterapia por meio da execução do plano de cuidado estabelecido.
  • Distribuir adequadamente a agenda de consultas, cumprindo a carga horária e número de atendimentos conforme contrato.

description:
Assistente Fiscal

Objetivos e Responsabilidades:

O Assistente Fiscal é responsável pelo suporte nas atividades fiscais e tributárias da empresa, incluindo o lançamento e emissão de notas fiscais, cálculo de impostos e conferência de notas. Este profissional também deve seguir os processos e procedimentos da empresa, checar a pré-entrada das notas fiscais dos fornecedores e criar bônus das notas fiscais para o processo de conferência do material. Além disso, deve resolver problemas relacionados aos lançamentos fiscais e garantir que todos os procedimentos estejam em conformidade com a legislação vigente.

Habilidades Específicas Requeridas

  1. Conhecimento da legislação tributária e fiscal.
  2. Experiência com sistemas de gestão fiscal e ERP.
  3. Habilidade em elaboração e análise de documentos fiscais.
  4. Capacidade de realizar conferência detalhada e correção de inconsistências.
  5. Boa comunicação para relacionamento com órgãos fiscais e suporte a outras áreas.

Atividades

Lançamento de Notas Fiscais

Realizar o lançamento de notas fiscais de entrada e saída no sistema.

Verificar a correta classificação fiscal dos produtos e serviços.

Emissão de Notas Fiscais

Emitir notas fiscais de venda, devolução, transferência e outros tipos conforme a necessidade da empresa.

Assegurar que todas as informações obrigatórias estejam presentes nas notas fiscais emitidas.

Cálculo de Impostos

Calcular os impostos devidos sobre as operações fiscais, como ICMS, ISS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, entre outros.

Garantir a correta aplicação das alíquotas e das regras fiscais.

Conferência de Notas Fiscais

Conferir as notas fiscais emitidas e recebidas, verificando se estão em conformidade com a legislação vigente.

Identificar e corrigir eventuais divergências ou inconsistências.

Resolução de Problemas Relacionados aos Lançamentos

Analisar e solucionar problemas relacionados aos lançamentos fiscais.

Manter contato com fornecedores e clientes para esclarecer dúvidas e resolver pendências fiscais.

Seguir os Processos e Procedimentos da Empresa

Seguir os processos e procedimentos estabelecidos pela empresa para garantir a conformidade e eficiência nas atividades fiscais.

Checar a Pré-entrada das Notas Fiscais dos Fornecedores

Verificar se as notas fiscais dos fornecedores foram corretamente lançadas no sistema.

Conferir se há pedidos de compra associados às notas fiscais no sistema Whintor.

Criar Bônus das NF´s para o Processo de Conferência do Material

Criar e controlar os bônus das notas fiscais para auxiliar no processo de conferência do material.

description:
A Natter está buscando um profissional para se juntar à nossa equipe como Operador de Máquinas. Se você possui experiência em operar máquinas agrícolas, de médio e de grande porte, a fim de atingir os resultados esperados e é apaixonado pelo que faz, esta oportunidade é para você!

Somos uma empresa do agronegócio brasileiro que atua na produção agrícola, pecuária e piscicultura. Temos o objetivo de promover a integração sustentável entre a natureza, as pessoas e a tecnologia para alavancar o crescimento da empresa, dos colaboradores, clientes e fornecedores, garantindo a prosperidade e a longevidade da nossa “grande família”.

A Natter nasceu em 2010 e, de lá para cá, tem avançado para promover a agricultura brasileira cada vez mais produtiva e sustentável. Somos feitos de pessoas, famílias e histórias e entendemos que dentro de cada pessoa existe um grande potencial para cooperar com todo o trabalho que é desenvolvido por aqui.

Nosso foco é a produção agrícola nas culturas de soja e milho, divididas nas duas safras anuais. Além disso, possuímos um trabalho com pecuária e piscicultura. Estamos divididos em 8 unidades de produção, espalhadas em 7 municípios de Mato Grosso.

O nome NATTER é a junção das palavras Natureza e Terra e por isso nos identificamos como #FelizesPorNatureza!

• Fé em Deus - Nos movemos por nossa fé em Deus crendo naquilo que Ele pode fazer.

Apply locations São Paulo, BR time type Full time posted on Posted 30+ Days Ago job requisition id 14069

Do you want to be part of a business that genuinely values entrepreneurialism , innovation and individual accountability? We focus on our customers and are proud of the difference our technology makes. We partner with some of the biggest manufacturing companies in the world and our technical innovations are used to enhance well-known brands across multiple industries.

Particle Measuring Systems specializes in viable and non-viable particle counters that measure and monitor contamination levels in clean, controlled environments. Since 1972, our team has been developing innovative technologies to advance the cleanroom monitoring industry. With unique technologies that provide customers with accurate and reliable information and results, Particle Measuring Systems is an international leader in the manufacture of particle counting and molecular and microbial monitoring instruments.

We are looking for a candidate for the position of Junior FMS Projects Analyst.

The candidate will be part of the installation and validation team operating in the company's Brazil office, and will be responsible for providing technical support to our customers in this area of activity.

In particular, the figure in question will be responsible for the following activities:

  1. Configuration, calibration and hardware installation, to be carried out in the office laboratory and on the customer's premises.
  2. Assessment of technical requirements and monitoring of the assembly of infrastructure (civil, electrical, network, automation) in a manufacturing environment.
  3. Understanding user requirements, risk assessment, traceability matrix, Gantt chart, activity list, project schedule, creation of specifications and validation documents, interpretation and creation of technical documentation (network diagrams, electrical schematics).
  4. Installation and configuration of software on a corporate network.
  5. Integration of systems into the client's domain.
  6. Project management activities in accordance with PMI recommended practices.
  7. Validation of computerized systems.
  8. Technical support for customers: Demonstrations, maintenance, troubleshooting, reports, specific training, both remotely and in the field.
  9. Collaboration with the Calibration Department to support scheduled activities in the office and in the field during peak workloads.

The ideal candidate

You are the ideal candidate if you meet the following requirements:

  1. Bachelor's degree in Electronic/Electrical Engineering or Computer Science; a diploma from any Technical Institute related to these areas will also be considered as a requirement, as long as the candidate has 5 years of professional experience in the role.
  2. More than 2 years of proven professional experience in a similar role.
  3. Knowledge of IT networks, creation and configuration of virtual machines, VNC, DameWare, VMware, vSphere, Hyper-V, domain controllers, domain policy, domain integration, PowerShell scripts, CAD, TeamViewer, Office365.
  4. It is necessary to be available to work in several different regions of Brazil.
  5. Good knowledge of English, written and oral, is required; Knowledge of Spanish will be an advantage.
  6. Previous professional experience in the life sciences industry will be an advantage.
  7. Availability to travel 40%.

We offer a competitive salary and benefit programs, including medical, dental, vision, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability programs, a flexible spending account, a tuition reimbursement program, a 401(k) plan, profit sharing, paid company holidays and paid time off. As part of our value system, we maintain a non-smoking campus and provide an onsite clinic for employees to emphasize health and well-being in the workplace. title: Operador de Pereciveis (GBarbosa) – Aracaju
description:
Ingressar no mercado de trabalho pode ser desafiador para muitos jovens, especialmente quando ainda estão estudando ou não possuem experiência profissional. É nesse cenário que o programa Jovem Aprendiz surge como uma excelente porta de entrada para quem deseja aprender, crescer e conquistar o seu espaço. Neste artigo, vamos explicar como funciona o programa, quem pode participar e quais são as vantagens de se tornar um jovem aprendiz.

Criado pela Lei da Aprendizagem (nº 10.097/2000), o programa Jovem Aprendiz tem como objetivo facilitar o ingresso de adolescentes e jovens no mundo do trabalho, oferecendo experiência prática aliada à formação teórica. Empresas de médio e grande porte são obrigadas por lei a contratar aprendizes, garantindo a eles um contrato especial de trabalho, com jornada reduzida e todos os direitos trabalhistas.

Quem pode ser Jovem Aprendiz?

O programa é destinado a jovens entre 14 e 24 anos , que estejam frequentando a escola (caso ainda não tenham concluído o ensino médio) ou que estejam matriculados em curso técnico ou de aprendizagem . O foco principal é oferecer oportunidade a quem busca o primeiro emprego, por isso não é necessário ter experiência anterior .

Como funciona o trabalho de um Jovem Aprendiz?

O jovem é contratado por um período determinado, geralmente de até dois anos , e durante esse tempo ele divide sua rotina entre as atividades práticas na empresa e a formação teórica em uma instituição parceira , como o SENAC, CIEE ou outras escolas profissionalizantes.

As funções exercidas variam de acordo com o setor da empresa, mas normalmente incluem tarefas administrativas, atendimento ao cliente, apoio logístico, organização de arquivos, entre outros . Tudo é feito de maneira supervisionada, com foco no aprendizado.

Além de adquirir experiência profissional e melhorar seu currículo, o jovem aprendiz tem direito a uma série de benefícios , como:

Salário compatível com a jornada de trabalho

Férias remuneradas (geralmente junto às escolares)

FGTS (com alíquota reduzida de 2%)

Carteira assinada

Curso de capacitação profissional

Além disso, muitas empresas efetivam os jovens após o período de aprendizagem , abrindo caminho para uma carreira promissora.

Os interessados devem ficar atentos às vagas divulgadas por empresas, sites especializados em empregos e instituições como o CIEE, IEL, Espro, entre outras. Ter um currículo simples e bem elaborado , com destaque para a formação escolar, cursos e atividades extracurriculares, pode fazer toda a diferença no processo seletivo.

Conclusão

Trabalhar como Jovem Aprendiz é uma experiência valiosa , que oferece muito mais do que um primeiro emprego. É uma chance real de crescimento pessoal e profissional , que pode abrir portas para uma carreira sólida. Se você está dentro da faixa etária e busca uma oportunidade de aprendizado e renda, o programa Jovem Aprendiz é o lugar certo para começar.

description:

Overview of Position:

The Desktop Services Administrator will ensure the proper operation of computer systems and software while providing technical support to end users globally. This role is responsible for configuring, deploying, maintaining, and troubleshooting mobile devices, PCs, laptops, and related peripherals quickly and effectively.

What you will do:

  1. Manage the software and hardware inventory, ensuring all equipment is correctly maintained and tracked.
  2. Provide training to end users on the use of all desktop-related hardware and software.
  3. Ensure all desktop systems comply with the company's security policies and procedures.
  4. Collaborate closely with Infrastructure and Applications teams to maintain healthy systems.
  5. Administer, maintain, and provide support for all desktop-related hardware and software, including workstations and printers.
  6. Troubleshoot and resolve any hardware or software-related issues reported by end users in a timely and efficient manner.
  7. Assist with IT infrastructure server setup and maintenance as requested by infrastructure team members.
  8. Support and troubleshoot end users remotely and in person.
  9. Manage and maintain desktop security, including virus protection and software patching.
  10. Manage user accounts and access rights, including file server access and onboarding/offboarding, with knowledge of Exchange and Azure AD.
  11. Oversee Thycotic Secret Server, including granting and revoking access through the admin console.
  12. Monitor the ticket queue to ensure service tickets are resolved and closed in a timely manner, following up with end users to confirm resolution.
  13. Support Microsoft Teams phone and the office badge system.

What we need from you:

  1. 3+ years of practical experience with managing systems, networks, and troubleshooting issues.
  2. Familiarity with network and server configuration, security protocols, and data management.
  3. Extensive familiarity with Windows and Mac operating systems, as well as related technologies (AD, Azure, GPO, Microsoft O365, Teams, Office Suite, Exchange, VMs, RDS, Endpoint Protection, Anywhere365, Proofpoint, Thinfinity, ServiceNow ticketing system, and Global Protect VPN).
  4. Expertise in various OSs such as Windows Server, Linux, Unix, and sometimes macOS.
  5. Knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, and network security.
  6. Experience with server installation, configuration, and maintenance.
  7. Experience with virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper-V, or KVM.
  8. Ability to write scripts (e.g., PowerShell, Bash) for automating tasks.
  9. Understanding of backup solutions and disaster recovery planning.
  10. Ability to work independently and manage multiple duties and priorities simultaneously.
  11. Capability to collaborate effectively with team members and end users.
  12. Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills for technical issues.
  13. Strong verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills.

Even better if you have:

  1. Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is often preferred.
  2. CompTIA A+ / CompTIA Network+
  3. Microsoft Certified: Windows Server or Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator
  4. Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA)
  5. VMware Certified Professional (VCP)
  6. Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)
  7. Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) – For a focus on security aspects
  8. Excellent ability to communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken required.

Speedcast is a leading communications and IT services provider, delivering critical communications services to various sectors. The company leverages its global network platform to provide fully connected systems that harness technologies and applications to transform what remote operations can achieve.

At Speedcast, we want people that like adventure and are motivated by work that takes uncommon ingenuity. If you want to be part of a global team responsible for connecting the world, then you’re in the right place.

We're always pushing forward and united by the adrenaline of high-stakes projects. You will experiment, learn, and grow here, right alongside us, every single day.

  • Our global presence – work with clients and colleagues all over the world.

title: Product Manager, LATAM (Mexico City, Mexico)
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

Our Product Marketing team imagines the ideal experience for our community and works backwards, creating innovative products that delight our guests and hosts. They deeply understand the needs of our users and translate these into a product strategy that combines strong product thinking and deep research. They partner with talented cross‑functional team members across engineering, design, operations, data science, and more, leading teams to execute a shared vision. They are incredibly detail‑oriented, hands‑on and excellent communicators, capable of crafting compelling stories for both internal and external audiences.

The Difference You Will Make

The International Product Marketing team is part of the Worldwide Product Marketing team. We are looking for entrepreneurial product experts who are ready to jump in, roll their sleeves up and integrate with local and regional teams, while maintaining close alignment with the worldwide teams. This role will help build out the new functional area outside of the US and will be instrumental in shaping the organization as it evolves. The cross‑functional model we use at Airbnb requires close partnerships across multiple teams – this role requires a highly collaborative, flexible individual who can influence and collaborate with teams across the world.

As the Product Manager based in our LATAM region, you will report to the Product Marketing Director for International Markets. As the product marketing leader for the market(s) in LATAM, you will play a pivotal role in understanding the needs, pain points, and behavior of users and translate those insights into innovative product features, capabilities and marketing strategies. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of the travel industry at a market and broader regional level, and have a proven track record of driving product innovation. You will collaborate with the global business and country teams to develop partnerships that accelerate existing and new businesses. You will drive features in major releases and for test and learn pilots, after having successfully championed customization and features for your target country/region. You will also determine how they are communicated to the public and the media in your region in partnership with other communications and marketing teams. You are responsible for the success of Airbnb products throughout their life cycle — from concept to release. You will be the voice of our products for the market in your region and love the journey from taking a product from idea to reality.

A Typical Day

  • Build deep expertise on Airbnb in your market/region through user research, marketplace data, and an understanding of the competitive landscape and be capable of synthesizing in a cohort product story input from multiple stakeholders and sources.
  • Work with other functional leaders in your market/region to articulate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Airbnb products and new businesses.
  • Implement best‑in‑class product development and management practices, including relevant go‑to‑market kits and information packs for local teams, while working with central and local teams.
  • Maintain and articulate a product feature and roadmap prioritization plan in collaboration with local teams.
  • Advocate for and execute new products that deliver impact for our business and users.
  • Communicate concisely and influence outcomes across all levels of the company, including country and regional executive teams.
  • Drive alignment across product teams (Technology, Design) and key cross‑functional partners (Business, Supply, FP&A, Marketing, Global Operations, Customer Support, Trust, etc.) to ensure initiatives are prioritized for wider roll‑out or piloted to test and learn.
  • Define goals and success with clearly measurable objectives and key results for your area.
  • Build and seamlessly integrate partnerships in your country/region that expand existing businesses and build new ones.
  • Navigate regulatory and government requirements in partnership with Policy/Comms and regions/markets.
  • Craft the product narrative and marketing strategies that communicate the benefits and features of products both internally and externally in collaboration with comms and other cross‑functional partners.
  • Develop and deliver engaging product demos to press, showcasing key features and functionalities.

Your Expertise

  • 10-15 years of product management experience.
  • Demonstrated track record of product leadership.
  • Comfortable with doing individual contributor product management work.
  • Success in building and scaling global consumer products and ecosystems that people love.
  • Experience creating product messaging and delivering to customers and the media.
  • Entrepreneurial track record of taking an idea to reality – start‑up experience a plus while capable of operating in a larger organization.
  • Ability to effectively use data and perform business analysis to support product strategy/decisions.
  • Capable of driving execution across teams in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Highly collaborative and results oriented.
  • Ability and willingness to travel around 30-35% of the time.
  • Fluency in English and at least one other local language (Spanish or Portuguese).

Your Location

This position is based in Mexico City, Mexico - Hybrid. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively‑led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

Our proactive approach ensures efficient operations, regulatory compliance, and enhances customer trust, maintaining our competitive edge and long‑term success.

Responsibilities

  • Risk and Control Self‑Assessment: Collaborate closely with various business units and Business Control Officers to identify, evaluate, and document operational risks and controls, based on the Nubank Methodology.
  • Evaluation of New Products and Features: Assess potential operational risks associated with the launch of new products, services, or features. Collaborate with product development teams to ensure that risk mitigation strategies are integrated into the design and implementation phases.
  • Incident Oversight: Conduct thorough reviews of operational incidents to identify and raise operational issues, map associated risks and controls, and accurately identify BDRO losses. Lead investigations to determine root causes and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Root Cause Analyses: Lead root cause analysis of operational risk incidents, identifying issues and helping the 1LoD to define corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Third‑Party Assessment: Assess suppliers in terms of Business Continuity Management governance.
  • Business Continuity Management (BCM): Support the First Line of Defense (1LoD) with the review and challenge of Business Continuity Management processes.
  • Issues Management: Identify, document, and track operational risk issues. Ensure timely resolution and implementation of corrective actions, while keeping stakeholders informed of progress and outcomes.

title: Operador(a) Produção E2G I - Afirmativa PCD
description:
Operador(a) Produção E2G I - Afirmativa PCD

Somos mais de 40 mil pessoas que atuam com foco em segurança, integridade, colaboração e simplificação, os pilares que sustentam nossa cultura. Geramos valor para nossos acionistas, clientes e parceiros e colaboradores a partir de um ecossistema integrado de negócios que começa com o cultivo da cana-de-açúcar até chegar na produção e comercialização de etanol, açúcar e bioenergia. Atuamos ainda – sob licença da marca Shell – na distribuição de combustíveis, lubrificantes e outras especialidades no Brasil, além de operações de refino na Argentina e distribuição de derivados de combustíveis e lubrificantes na Argentina e no Paraguai. Se identificou?

Estamos em busca de Operador(a) Produção E2G I para atuar no time de EAB em Valparaíso-SP .

Responsabilidades e atribuições

COMO SERÁ O SEU DIA A DIA

  • Garantir operação padronizada de acordo com os procedimentos (POP) e parâmetros de processo (Mapa de processo), buscando sempre melhoria contínua;
  • Realizar Inspeções de linhas e equipamentos, visando identificar perdas e anomalias;
  • Limpeza interna de equipamentos;
  • Realizar amostragens, coletas e análises, avaliando sólidos, pH, temperatura, concentração, etc.;
  • Carregamento e descarregamento de insumos, e conferência de nota fiscal;
  • Responsável pelo controle de estoque de insumos, realizando as reposições e garantindo continuidade das dosagens e FIFO entre os produtos;
  • Operação de empilhadeira para atividades rotineiras;
  • Limpeza e organização da área;
  • Apoio a pequenas manutenções operacionais, em válvulas, trocadores de calor, filtros rotativos, etc.;
  • Execução das ferramentas de segurança e do sistema Alerta (AAS, AST, Intervenção);
  • Participar das ferramentas do SER+ (5S, Kaizen e PDCA);
  • Trabalhar em equipe, compartilhando informações e atividades com os demais colaboradores;
  • Garantir o reporte de informações entre os turnos;
  • Reportar atividades e resultados ao gestor da área;

Requisitos e qualifications

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Desejável formação técnica completa ou cursando (Açúcar e álcool, química ou papel e celulose);
  • Pacote office básico;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em turnos 5X1;
  • Desejável conhecimento em ferramentas de melhoria contínua: Lean, 5S, Trabalho padronizado, Kaizen;
  • Disponibilidade para residir em Valparaíso-SP, Guararapes-SP, Mirandópolis-SP.

Informações adicionais

ETAPAS DO PROCESSO SELETIVO

Nosso processo contempla 3 etapas principais (podem ter outras, e você ficará por dentro caso avance):

  • Inscrição - preenchimento deste formulário e de dados adicionais, caso necessário.
  • Entrevista com o RH - um bate-papo para nos conhecermos.
  • Entrevista com a liderança: bate-papo mais técnico para contar ainda mais sobre o dia a dia e os desafios.

Nossa comunicação será por e-mail e telefone - confira se seus dados estão atualizados.

title: Senior Business Development Manager
description:
We are looking for a highly experienced and connected professional to join Kokku as a Senior Business Development Manager, focused on driving strategic partnerships and sales with AAA studios and enterprise clients. This role is remote-friendly but based in Recife (Brazil) or Lisbon(Portugal), where proximity to key partners and major industry players enables deeper collaboration. You won’t be managing a team—instead, you’ll be owning relationships, leading negotiations, and shaping our growth strategy through meaningful, high-value partnerships.

As Senior Business Development Manager you will:
• Build and expand Kokku’s presence through trusted relationships with AAA developers, publishers, and platform holders.
• Identify and pursue long-term partnership opportunities with enterprise clients in the games and interactive entertainment industries.
• Lead strategic pitches and negotiations, driving deals from prospecting to close.
• Represent Kokku at major industry events (GDC, DICE, Gamescom, etc.), acting as a key face of our business.
• Collaborate with executive leadership to shape business development strategies tailored to the market.
• Maintain and grow a pipeline of high-value opportunities, ensuring alignment with Kokku’s capabilities and production strengths.
• Provide market and partner intelligence that informs internal strategy and service development.
• Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, proactively identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

Requirements:
• Based in Recife (Brazil) or Lisbon(Portugal) or willing to relocate.
• 6+ years of business development experience in the games or entertainment industry, with a strong focus on AAA or enterprise-level clients.
• Proven ability to close complex, high-value partnerships.
• Deep understanding of the AAA development and publishing landscape.
• Strong network in the games industry across business and creative leadership roles.
• Excellent communicator, negotiator, and relationship-builder with executive-level presence.
• Comfortable with regular domestic and occasional international travel for client meetings and industry events.
• Strategic thinker who thrives in a fast-moving, collaborative environment.

Nice to Have:
• Experience with co-development, art outsourcing, or live service partnerships.
• Understanding of development pipelines and publisher-developer dynamics.
• Familiarity with contracts and service agreements for external development.
Benefits:

  • Health Insurance
  • A transparent and inclusion-oriented culture
  • Relocation bonus
  • Meal ticket
  • Transport benefits and more
  • A full-time job in a modern and relaxed studio atmosphere
  • A chance to work within an international team
  • A lot of challenges and ambitious tasks
  • An opportunity to grow in a stimulating industry

title: Model Risk Senior Specialist
description:
About Nubank:
Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow, and inefficient financial system. Since then, through innovative technology and outstanding customer service, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is one of the world's largest digital banking platforms and technology‑leading companies.
Today, Nubank is a global company with offices in São Paulo (Brazil), Mexico City (Mexico), Buenos Aires (Argentina), Bogotá (Colombia), Durham (United States), and Berlin (Germany). It was founded in 2013 in Sao Paulo by Colombian David Vélez, and cofounded by Brazilian Cristina Junqueira and American Edward Wible. For more information, visit

About the team

At Nubank we heavily rely on data, machine learning, and AI to drive our strategy and provide the best experience and products to our customers. The Model Risk team plays a crucial role in ensuring Nubank relies on world‑class models that meet business and customer needs, and have associated risks under control. We act by providing effective review & challenge and identifying opportunities to improve our models. We also act by implementing governance and validation standards to control the risk of our models, as well as by establishing feedback loops to constantly improve them.

The position

This is a senior individual contributor role that will require experience in machine learning and analytics, along with knowledge of Expected Credit Loss and its parameters (PD, EAD, LGD).

You will be responsible for

  • Conduct independent reviews of quantitative models based on financial, statistical, and machine learning techniques, with a focus on credit risk provisions and capital
  • Provide effective challenge to models and modelling processes, identify risks and engage with other teams to strengthen our decision‑making tools and capabilities.
  • Develop playbooks and toolkits (e.g., Python, SQL, Scala) to optimize model reviews, ongoing monitoring, and assess the impact of models on decision‑making.
  • Contribute to the construction of Nubank's Model Risk Management and Model Review processes with autonomy and creativity.
  • Discuss and report model risk status and receive independent opinions from various stakeholders, including senior managers and regulators.
  • Be exposed to models from different countries and regulatory requirements.
  • Have a strong understanding of relevant local and international regulations and accounting standards concerning credit provisions, including BACEN 4966 and IFRS9.
  • Ensure the team maintains technical excellence and actively contributes to establishing model risk controls and processes that strengthen compliance with regulations.
  • Mentor junior staff on best practices for Model Oversight and Validation.
  • Work in a multicultural, diverse and highly skilled environment.

We are looking for a person who has

  • Experience developing or validating quantitative and/or machine learning models, with a focus on credit provisions and capital requirements models.
  • Interest in reviewing complex machine learning and other types of models to identify risks and propose enhancements.
  • Data Science skills, strong knowledge of machine learning tools and techniques.
  • Strong programming skills, desirable previous experience with Python, SQL, GitHub.
  • Ability to learn fast, strong analytical, and problem‑solving skills.
  • Organized and detail‑oriented, without losing track of the big picture.
  • English language proficiency.
  • Experience in relevant local and international regulations and accounting standards related to credit provisions and capital, such as BACEN 4966, IFRS9, ICAAP.

Benefits

  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Meal allowance
  • Transportation assistance
  • 30 days of paid vacation
  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank
  • Parking partnership - discounted parking in our office
  • Free bike parking with showers available
  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program
  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program
  • Gympass partnership
  • Extended maternity and paternity Leaves
  • Child care allowance
  • ‘Espaço Feijão’- Private nursing and breastfeeding spaces in our buildings
  • Onsite Health Center - Medical support for every Nubanker in our office

Responsabilidades e atribuições

1.Qualidade técnica dos projetos

4. Elaboração de relatórios técnicos

You’ll partner cross‑functionally with Product, Game Design, and Marketing to drive game strategy, optimise the player experience, and deliver measurable improvements through experimentation.

  • Contribute to data modelling and pipeline improvements using dbt and SQL
  • Proactively prioritise high‑impact projects in a fast‑paced, iterative development environment

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, with at least 2+ years in gaming
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and data visualization (ideally Tableau)
  • Experience with A/B testing design, execution, and interpretation
  • Strong product intuition and an ability to turn data into a clear, compelling narrative
  • Familiarity with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred)
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort presenting findings to both technical and non‑technical teams
  • Comfortable working independently, with a bias for action and experimentation

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Roblox or other UGC platforms
  • Proficiency in Python for analysis or automation
  • Understanding of player segmentation, LTV modelling, and funnel diagnostics
  • Experience working on live service games or mobile F2P products

Hands‑on experience with dbt and working with structured datasets

We look for candidates who can confidently build and maintain data pipelines, transform data, and create reusable models.

We are looking for motivated, customer-focused people who want to join our team as a Reliability Maintenance Engineering Area Manager. Join us in the Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering team. We maintain and optimize technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse & Delivery Network.
